dateAssessment: Working opening date: January 29, 1730 from the session YAML, not an independently spoken day of month. The DM confirms 1730 and late January (u0205, u0724–u0726). The recovery, short rest and Melusa evacuation belong to that opening-day action, but t08 explicitly adds a few days of Taelgar rescue work and t09 resolves later resettlement. The time extraction therefore records a conflict with the same-day YAML end; no replacement end date is inferred. Melusa’s civil watch is undated. Its stated 1:4 time ratio is context for urgency, not an elapsed interval to add. Stars after the Taelgar short rest describe lighting; the loose 14:30/15:30 estimate plus one hour still falls in the fixed afternoon watch.

watches.summary: DM estimates 14:30/15:30; a ten-minute ritual and one-hour rest end with stars visible.
